violation_type.title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep (26 TAC §747.2805(1))
violation_type.short_title: Children Not Required to Sleep - May Not Force Child to Sleep
violation_type.typical_finding: One child was sleeping on a nap time mat  with their head covered by their blanket. This was corrected when the caregiver uncovered their head.

finding_variants.text: One child was sleeping on a nap time mat  with their head covered by their blanket. This was corrected when the caregiver uncovered their head.
Two children were sleeping on nap time mats with their heads covered by their blanket. This was corrected when the caregiver uncovered their heads.
